nina: Heads-up: validator spike on /summarize in eu-central starting 09:12. ~12x rejects.
kevin: Any quick error traces?
nina: From validator stream:
```
2026-03-04T09:12:03Z validator=fnhook route=/summarize region=eu-central error="schema: union mismatch, received null for non-nullable branch" sample=sg100
2026-03-04T09:12:04Z validator=fnhook route=/summarize region=eu-central error="toolcall: expected object with 'tool' key, got null" sample=sg101
```
rahul: This smells like the union typing we added for optional attachments. Model sometimes emits explicit nulls for steps and our coercer maps null->missing and then validator rejects.
kevin: We also recently routed 5% of eu-central to permissive-coercion canary. Could be interaction.
nina: Console shows these as REJECTED and they are being routed to degen-fallback. Billing tag currently = fncall. Ops: are customers getting billed?
ops-oncall: If tagged fncall they'll get charged. I can mute billing alerts for /summarize eu-central for 30m.
rahul: Immediate actions proposed: 1) increase validator sampling to 100% for /summarize in eu-central for 10m, 2) flip permissive-coercion=false for canary in region, 3) add metric validator.union_outcome label {route,region,branch} and surface top sample ids.
nina: Also request small console change: replace opaque "REJECTED" with "REJECTED (union:null)" when union mismatch detected, and show a one-line example payload. That would speed triage.
kevin: I'll flip sampling and rollback toggle now. Deploy-bot, enqueue rollback of permissive-coercion for canary eu-central by kevin.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued by kevin  id=11321 expected ~09:14.
console-bot: note: created follow-up ticket ENG-20322 for dashboard metric + console badge + sample extractor.
rahul: Also recommend emitting billing_exempt=true when fallback==degen and validator rejects are due to known coercion-canary. We can auto-suppress billing while canary is active.
ops-oncall: Muting billing alerts for /summarize eu-central for 30m (mute id M-4730).
nina: Sampling up to 100% now. Will paste 3 sample ids to ENG-20322 once we collect them. Early signal: rejects trending down after rollback. Thread_ts=1777554321. :thumbsup:
